question: First vendor call that transitions BCM4352 AC from radio-OFF to radio-ON
verdict: FOUND (vendor-executed): wlc_phy_init @0xbad44 -> wlc_phy_switch_radio(pi, ON=1) -> wlc_phy_switch_radio_acphy(pi, ON=1)
supersedes: d4c_radio_on_transition.md claim that the only on=1 entry is the RPC-dispatched wlc_bmac_radio_hw

transition.on_branch_entry: 0xaa7bb (je 0xAB413 is the OFF path when sil==0)
transition.chanspec_at_moment: [pi+0x17e] set in wlc_phy_init 0xbac19 from the u16 argument; wlc_phy_chanspec_shm_set called at 0xbac31 before the switch
transition.band: derived from chanspec & 0xc000 (band field); band struct selected earlier by wlc_setxband in wlc_bmac_init

predicates.runtime_branch: [pi+0x16e] selects ON-path variant: ==1 -> long path (sub_8fb39/PLL poll 0xaaab6); ==2 -> 0xaab42 path (sub_9027d + write_radio_reg 0x60c + PLL poll); else -> 0xaabf0 (skip to sub_9fb72)

candidates: branch [pi+0x16e]==2: sub_9027d @0xaab50 (PHY PLL/clock regs 0x836/0x852/0x839/0x837/0x838) then write_radio_reg(0x60c,0x9e) @0xaab62, then lock poll read_radio_reg(0x0b)&1 and read_radio_reg(0x20b)&1 (<=0x65 iters) @0xaabbb
branch [pi+0x16e]==1: radio 0x80b sequence and PLL-lock poll read_radio_reg(0x80b)&1 @0xaaab6 (<=0x65 iters)
